title: Unify `discoveryOnly` with recursive crawl flow and suppress parser event extraction
body:
`discoveryOnly` was implemented as a separate traversal path (`discoverUrlTree`), which diverged from normal crawl behavior. This change makes discovery-only use the same recursive crawl pipeline as normal execution, while preventing event construction.

- **SharedCore flow unification**
  - Removed discovery-only branching from `processParser` and routed both modes through `crawlUrlsForEvents`.
  - Added `discoveryOnly` + `discoveryTreeCollector` plumbing to crawl recursion so URL traversal semantics match normal mode.

- **Discovery outputs from normal crawl**
  - Built `discoveryTree` (`rootUrls`, `edges`, `allNodes`) during recursive crawl instead of via a separate BFS helper.
  - Continued returning `mermaidGraph` and `asciiTree` in discovery-only parser results from the collected tree.

- **Parser behavior in discovery-only mode**
  - Updated parsers to honor `parserConfig.discoveryOnly` and return `events: []` while still producing `additionalLinks`:
    - `ai-web`, `linktree`, `bearracuda`, `chunk`, `redeyetickets`, `scriptable-url`.
  - Preserves recursive URL discovery while disabling event extraction/normalization work.

- **Config clarity**
  - Updated `scraper-input.js` discovery-only comment to reflect new semantics: normal crawl/discovery flow, event extraction skipped.

```js
// shared-core.js (conceptual)
await this.crawlUrlsForEvents({
  ...,
  discoveryOnly: effectiveParserConfig.discoveryOnly === true,
  discoveryTreeCollector
});
```
